description: Defines the ModuleDefaultPage entity class for ORM mapping, representing default page configurations for modules in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ModuleDefaultPage
classes.description: Entity class representing default page settings for modules, including properties like action, enable class, priority, user role, and module association.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the ModuleDefaultPage entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the ModuleDefaultPage entity.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action associated with the default page.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action for the default page.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the default page configuration.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the default page configuration.
